text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I lost again... And here I thought I 
had it... Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Racing is fun, but winning makes it way, 
waaaay more fun!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Uuuu--nnh! I'm kinda getting fired up!
choice_data_list: Let's train when we get back!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I swear on carrot ice cream!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Until I win, I swore I'd only eat one a 
day...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Nice, nice! If we do our best 
starting now, we'll definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry home! At a full sprint!

Afterward, I did some extra training with 
a highly motivated Haru Urara.
